sql_text: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders
SELECT c_custkey,c_name FROM customer WHERE c_acctbal > 1000
SELECT o_orderkey,o_totalprice FROM orders WHERE o_totalprice > 50000
SELECT c_nationkey,COUNT(*) FROM customer GROUP BY c_nationkey
SELECT o_orderstatus,COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY o_orderstatus
SELECT * FROM customer ORDER BY c_acctbal DESC
SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c_nationkey) FROM customer
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderstatus) FROM orders
SELECT c.c_name,o.o_orderkey FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey=o.o_custkey
SELECT c.c_name,o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey=o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice>10000
SELECT c.c_name,SUM(o.o_totalprice) FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey=o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_name
SELECT c.c_nationkey,AVG(o.o_totalprice) FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey=o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders)
SELECT * FROM customer WHERE c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c_acctbal) FROM customer)
SELECT c.c_name,o.o_orderkey,l.l_quantity FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey=o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey=l.l_orderkey
SELECT c.c_name,SUM(l.l_extendedprice) FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey=o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey=l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_name
SELECT * FROM lineitem WHERE l_quantity > 20 AND l_discount < 0.05
SELECT * FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate > DATE '1995-01-01'
